title: Module 15 Interpretation Check
intro: Each item gives you a short research situation. Decide what the evidence supports.

items.q: Sixty students choose a study setting: 20 of 30 who studied in a group passed, and 10 of 30 who studied alone passed. What is the expected frequency of passing in each cell if setting and passing were independent?
items.why: Row total 30 times column total 30 divided by N 60 = 15.

items.q: Using observed 20, 10, 10, 20 and expected 15 in each cell, what is chi-square?
items.why: Each cell contributes 25/15 = 1.667, and four cells give 6.67.

items.q: For a 2 by 2 table the degrees of freedom are 1 and the critical value at .05 is 3.84. What is the decision?
o: Reject the null. Setting and passing are related
Retain the null. They are independent
Retain the null since N is small
Reject the null since the odds ratio is 1

items.q: What is the odds ratio for group study versus studying alone?
items.why: Group odds = 20/10 = 2. Alone odds = 10/20 = .5. The ratio is 2/.5 = 4.

items.q: What is phi for these data?
items.why: Phi = the square root of 6.67/60 = .333, a medium association.
